ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

color.note: The checked box follows the semantic color.

description.label: Form control for boolean selection with native input, indeterminate state, multiple appearances, colors, sizes, and states.
description.large-text: Get urgent alerts by text message.
description.note: Description renders muted supporting text under the label and scales with size.

examples.note: A boolean toggle with a native input. The visual box stays in sync with the input state.

checkbox.form-field-hint: You must accept the terms to continue.

indeterminate.note: Indeterminate is a visual state separate from checked. Clicking clears indeterminate and sets checked.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the checkbox component.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

radius.note: The control box supports sm (default), md, lg, xl, and full radius values. Full is an alias of xl.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3x3 matrix: both change the control box, density also changes the label gap.
